name: australian-employment-fair-work
description: Map Australian Fair Work obligations and review employment contracts, worker classification, discrimination and positive duties, restraints and underpayment exposure frameworks against official sources for qualified lawyer review.

interface.shortDescription: Maps Fair Work obligations and reviews contracts, classification, discrimination, restraints and underpayment frameworks for lawyers.
interface.longDescription: Ten controlled Australian employment workflows using an approved employment profile and official-source evidence. Adds contract review, worker-classification and high-income opt-out screening, discrimination and positive-duty controls, restraint review with proposed reform status, and an underpayment framework without invented rates or final calculations. Every conclusion remains with a qualified lawyer.
defaultPrompt: Create a controlled employment profile for this employer before mapping its Fair Work obligations.
Map the NES, award and agreement entitlements that apply to this employee's arrangement.
Issue-spot the termination exposure for this proposed dismissal and the Fair Work Commission time limits.
Review this workplace policy set against the current Fair Work Act hooks.
Check the Fair Work watch register and tell me what has changed since our last review.
